column2: † Oracle is a privileged simulation-only reference. PRA and TTA compare the engine-computable risk-aware priority with its latent-reference counterpart along each policy-induced trajectory. These metrics correspond to the actual competence-targeting mechanism only for the Proposed Framework, which directly uses the risk-aware priority ranking. For the other policies, PRA and TTA characterize the diagnostic agreement of the risk-aware ranking along their induced trajectories rather than the targeting rule used by those policies. DCM and NCCE characterize policy-induced practice allocation.
